shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular marker at the edge of a marked interval or at a point on a plotted trace. Compare the mark at 1 on the number line on the left with the left-hand mark at (−3,0) on the right.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The displayed set includes 1 at its upper bound. Right image: The point belongs to the plotted graph and gives f(−3)=0.
Rationales: On the left, the filled endpoint marks an inclusive boundary of the marked ray. On the right, the filled marker adds that coordinate pair to the graph and supplies the value at its horizontal coordinate.
